purpose: Pre-Unity cinematic-intent QA for CUTSCENE_SCRIPT_V1. These checks protect authoring truth and do not replace Unity validation. The status model is GREEN exact, YELLOW deterministic auto-repair/minor, ORANGE visible semantic or preview degradation, RED only when an honest result cannot safely continue.

validationStatusModel.principle: Color describes what happens to the film; owner describes who can fix it. Only RED blocks Editable Preview.

green.label: EXACT
green.meaning: The authored intent can be represented as requested.

yellow.label: AUTO_REPAIRED
yellow.meaning: The backend changed or supplied a deterministic low-level mechanic without materially changing visible semantic intent.

orange.label: SEMANTIC_DEVIATION
orange.meaning: The film can continue, but the visible result or preview differs materially from authored intent. Never substitute another identity to hide the deviation.

red.label: CANNOT_SAFELY_PRODUCE
red.meaning: No honest legal result can continue without invalid identity, invented data, incompatible CURRENT truth, or unrecoverable semantic corruption.

ownershipModel.AUTHORING: The JSON/CURRENT authoring choice is invalid and ChatGPT can fix it from published authoring truth.
ownershipModel.BACKEND: The backend owns the deterministic normalization/default.
ownershipModel.ENGINE: The authored identity is valid but Unity/editor/runtime execution could not realize it. Do not tell ChatGPT to change valid JSON merely to hide this.
ownershipModel.rule: A known exact CURRENT identity that later fails resolver/materialization is ENGINE-owned. For Editable Preview it is ORANGE with an explicit placeholder/omission and no substitute; it is not an AUTHORING RED.

editablePreviewGate.orangeBehavior: Continue Editable Preview using an explicit diagnostic placeholder or omission owned by the preview/materializer. Preserve the exact authored identity in diagnostics. Do not select a replacement asset.
editablePreviewGate.freezeAcceptedJson: Once authoring integrity is accepted, downstream YELLOW/ORANGE engine findings do not require regenerating or rewriting the source JSON.

redIsReservedFor: destination route/capability mismatch that cannot be materialized or honestly degraded
schema or semantic corruption with no deterministic legal repair
invented visual/3D evidence that contradicts CURRENT
warningExamples: missing explicit low-level dialogue-stage background when the backend has a deterministic legal stage default
missing explicit dialogue frame when the backend has a deterministic legal frame default
backend-selected locked dialogue normalizes authored Push/Pull to legal Hold
orangeExamples: a legal authored cinematic move must be visibly downgraded to a different legal move
a valid exact CURRENT visual cannot be materialized in Editable Preview and is shown as an explicit missing/diagnostic placeholder
a legal exact dialogue presentation lacks preview pixel evidence, so the exact portrait cannot be shown
a requested visible count or presentation cannot be fully realized but the rest of the cutscene can continue honestly
validationSeverityPolicy.principle: Do not turn backend or engine implementation failures into authoring RED when the source identity is legal. YELLOW is invisible/minor deterministic repair; ORANGE is visible deviation or degraded preview; RED means the cutscene cannot safely continue.

dialogueStageContract.simpleV1Boundary: Simple V1 authors semantic dialogue, exact curated participants, locationHandle/presentation intent and story context. It does not invent V5 dialogue-frame or stage-background runtime IDs merely to satisfy lower-level staging mechanics.
dialogueStageContract.backendOwnership: The existing Adapter/Unity dialogue-stage owner must supply deterministic system-managed FACE_TO_FACE_PORTRAITS stage mechanics, including a legal full-frame background and dialogue frame when that presentation requires them.

simpleV1Semantics.cinematicMove: Maps to existing V3 Beat/Feature vocabulary when exact; otherwise preserve visible evidence and lower-level legal actions without lying about a feature.
simpleV1Semantics.motionIntent: Semantic movement vocabulary including flyby, approach, orbit, intercept, pursuit, escort, rescue, landing, takeoff and human movement intents.
simpleV1Semantics.cameraOrbit: 2D/2.5D orbit-like parallax only. Never synthesize an unseen 3D side/back view.
simpleV1Semantics.performanceIntent: Resolved through existing performance/animation compatibility, never raw clip IDs.
simpleV1Semantics.audio: Direct CURRENT Audio handles only. Route, preview safety and publish safety remain authoritative.
simpleV1Semantics.continuity: Preserves screen direction and named continuity subjects between beats.

rules.description: The camera/creative focal target has no visible or entering evidence in the beat.
A camera move names a subject that is never visibly present during the beat.
A semantic cinematic move such as flyby, approach, orbit, intercept, pursuit or escort is flattened to a meaningless straight move without trajectory evidence.
Orbit intent exists but no legal 2D trajectory/parallax or existing Orbit-capable route can evidence it.
Orbit intent invents a 3D viewpoint, back side or model geometry not present in CURRENT visual evidence.
audio[].handle does not resolve exactly to CURRENT route Audio.
Audio is preview-usable but safeForPublish=false. Preview may continue, final publish-ready authoring must not claim readiness.
A performance/animation intent has no compatible CURRENT animation or deterministic fallback.
A declared left/right/ahead/behind/faces/threatens/follows/escorts/protects relationship is not reflected in visible staging.
preserveScreenDirection=true but matchedEntityIds is empty even though moving continuity-bearing entities exist.
A matched entity reverses established screen travel without an authored reason or transition.
An impact/destruction claim has no visible reaction, state change, effect or final-state evidence.
Dialogue presentation removes world evidence that the beat still depends on.

A FACE_TO_FACE_PORTRAITS dialogue beat omitted an explicit low-level stage background. The existing dialogue-stage owner may inject its deterministic legal full-frame background and compilation should continue.
A FACE_TO_FACE_PORTRAITS dialogue beat omitted an explicit low-level dialogue frame. The existing dialogue-stage owner may inject its deterministic legal frame and compilation should continue.

Simple V1 authored a semantic Push/Pull but the backend selected locked dialogue staging; compiled camera coverage is deterministically normalized to legal Hold. Source intent remains in diagnostic metadata.

The requested dialogue presentation cannot obtain a legal deterministic stage/background/frame through the existing dialogue-stage owner. Do not invent arbitrary Layer/Ui assets or change character identity to silence this error.

The exact authored CURRENT identity is valid and preview-safe, but the editor/materializer could not realize it. Editable Preview continues with an explicit diagnostic placeholder or omission; no replacement identity is selected.
A legal cutscene can continue, but a visible authored intent cannot be reproduced exactly and is downgraded to a disclosed legal presentation.
Three or more consecutive dialogue beats reuse effectively the same presentation, framing and transition.
A major physical story claim lacks corresponding visible/action/effect evidence. The preview may continue, but the film will not communicate the authored claim as intended.
cinematicMove is declared but the beat contains no staging/camera/action evidence that expresses it. The preview may continue, but visible intent is degraded.

hardAuthoringInvariants: AUTHORING_HANDLES.json is the only Simple V1 handle source.
Simple V1 does not author runtime assetId/GUID/revision/hash fields.
Unknown or ambiguous handles remain RED.
Audio handles must resolve to route Audio.
Emotional Dialogue actorId/identityHandle/expression legality remains RED when invalid; presentation defaults never weaken identity rules.
Missing low-level FACE_TO_FACE_PORTRAITS background/frame is YELLOW when the existing backend has a deterministic legal stage default; it is RED only when no legal stage can be resolved.
Backend-selected locked-dialogue camera incompatibility is normalized before V3 validation and reported YELLOW; V3's invariant itself remains unchanged.
Known exact CURRENT identity plus downstream preview resolver/materialization failure is ENGINE ORANGE for Editable Preview, not AUTHORING RED. Keep exact identity and use no substitute.
ORANGE never silently changes identity. It must preserve authored truth and disclose the visible deviation.
Orbit means legal 2D/2.5D screen/parallax evidence, never invented 3D.
Preview success is not final readiness when ORANGE exists or any referenced CURRENT record has safeForPublish=false.
